Control Description: Maintain a governance charter and RACI that defines roles, decision rights, and escalation paths.
Document COI policy and ensure major changes receive independent review by non-operator stakeholders.
Record governance decisions and enforcement actions with attribution and immutable history.
Implement proposal→approval→activation lifecycle with versions and rollback references.
Publish registry/list content with signatures and authorized publishers.
Include provenance, timestamps, update cadence, and deprecation markers in publications.
Operate a dispute intake and correction process with timelines and public outcomes.
Define availability targets and backups for registry services; test recovery periodically.
Bind issuer authorization to registry listing and governance approval.
Capture issuance events with subject binding, policy checks, and signer attribution.
Provide status/revocation mechanism with reliable propagation and deprecation policy.
Verify issuer authorization, schema conformance, and status before acceptance.
Present user consent prompts and retain minimal audit of consent choices.
Define delegated authority boundaries and detect violations via monitoring or logs.
Maintain monitoring and escalation playbooks for outages, abuse, and policy violations.
Publish plain-language recourse guidance and error messaging conventions.
Maintain key inventory; rotate keys; define compromise response.
Document accepted algorithms and deprecation policy; verify implementations comply.
Log signing/rotation/revocation events with attribution.
Maintain dependency inventory with owners, SLAs, and fallback plans.
Version schemas; publish compatibility notes; document breaking changes.
Run periodic reviews of incidents and control effectiveness; log actions.
Verify AIS-1 v0.2 SOA parent DID resolution parent ALA status and cascade revocation behavior before accepting the SOA as an accountability input.
Require DID resolution registry status bond hash tier issuer timestamp service and assurance-container evidence where applicable.

Control Name: AIS-1 cascade revocation and fail-safe handling
Control Description: Demonstrate downgrade denial or review behavior when AIS-1 bond state parent ALA state registry state or timestamp evidence is stale revoked unknown or unavailable.
